decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
response.rationale: The patient's positive SARS-CoV-2 test and elevated inflammatory cytokines are more specific to COVID-19-associated myocarditis than the general cardiac damage indicated by the runner-up

rejected.why: Thrombotic microangiopathy is a possible contributor, but not the primary diagnosis
Acute coronary syndrome is unlikely due to the absence of coronary artery disease
Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) is not the primary diagnosis, as the patient's presentation is more cardiac-focused
